ms.report:
As part of a broader initiative to promote Cardano, spotlight its community, and highlight its sustainability efforts, Clay Nation, Cattle Daddy Media, and Sustainable ADA joined forces. Together, we launched two campaigns - including creating Cardano-focused in-person content at two major crypto events and a set of webinars - to spread awareness around Cardano, sustainability and the ecosystem.
For Milestone 2 (Campaign 1), we attended Consensus Hong Kong 2025 to create a wide range of content on Cardano for digital outreach. We also hosted sustainability-driven webinars and explored a variety of Cardano4Good topics, with active participation from community members.
The media output included 20 videos - twice the amount originally planned (we got creatively carried away!). These included short-form skits, interviews, and highlight reels. The content captured key moments from the event, spotlighted builders and projects within the Cardano ecosystem, and told authentic stories that sparked conversation, showcased innovation, and attempted to bring Cardano’s mission to life in a fresh, entertaining, and imaginative way.
In addition to on-site content creation, the campaign extended online with two educational webinars, hosted via Zoom and X Spaces. These sessions featured group discussions and interactive talks focused on Cardano’s approach to sustainability and how blockchain can be used for real-world impact.
To wrap up Campaign 1, this Post-Event & Content Analysis Report examines performance metrics, audience engagement, and community response. These insights are intended to provide critical thought and help guide future campaigns, ensuring even stronger alignment with Cardano’s mission, the community’s voice, and relevant SDG outcomes.
Many thanks for following along.
Find further details of our proof of achievement below:
https://light-navy-ab0.notion.site/Consensus-Hong-Kong-Post-Event-Campaign-Analysis-237b65af42778004a40ddacbe67894ef
